# Import & Data Cleaning

```{r import}
df.raw <- read.csv('Life Expectancy Data.csv')
df.raw <- na.omit(df.raw)
df <- df.raw
```

# Categorical variables

Only `Country` and `Status` are categorical.

```{r categorical-country}
## countries
country_freq_table <- table(df$Country)
plot(country_freq_table)
```

```{r categorical-status}
## status
status_freq_table <- table(df$Status)
plot(status_freq_table)
```

# Numerical variables

```{r numeric-cols}
(numeric.cols <- df[, sapply(df, is.numeric)])
```

```{r numeric-scatterplots}
lapply(names(numeric.cols), function(column_name) {
  plot(numeric.cols[[column_name]],
       numeric.cols$Life.expectancy,
       xlab = column_name,
       ylab = "Life Expectancy")
})
```
`percentage.expenditure`, ``
```{r log-transform-elgibility}
lapply(names(numeric.cols), function(column_name) {
  par(mfrow=c(1, 2))
  
  lm.preTransform <- lm(
    numeric.cols$Life.expectancy ~ numeric.cols[[column_name]]
  )
  
  lm.postTransform <- lm(
    numeric.cols$Life.expectancy ~ log1p(numeric.cols[[column_name]])
  )
  
  lm.preTrans.pval <- summary(lm.preTransform)$coefficients[,4]
  lm.postTrans.pval <- summary(lm.postTransform)$coefficients[,4]
  
  plot(numeric.cols[[column_name]],
       numeric.cols$Life.expectancy,
       xlab = column_name,
       ylab = "Life Expectancy",
       main = lm.preTrans.pval
       )
  plot(log1p(numeric.cols[[column_name]]),
     numeric.cols$Life.expectancy,
     xlab = cat("log(",column_name,")"),
     ylab = "Life Expectancy",
     main = lm.postTrans.pval
  )
})
```

```{r}
# Identify outliers with the 1.5 * IQR rule
is_outlier <- function(x) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x < (q[1] - 1.5 * iqr) | x > (q[2] + 1.5 * iqr)
}

numeric_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
outlier_rows <- apply(sapply(df[, numeric_cols], is_outlier), 1, any)

cat("Rows before removing outliers:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Rows with outliers removed:", sum(outlier_rows), "\n")
df <- df[!outlier_rows, ]
cat("Rows remaining:", nrow(df), "\n")
```
